abilities.name: pickpocket
abilities.effect: Steals attacking Pokémon's held items on contact.

original-johto.flavorText: This cunning POKéMON hides under the cover of darkness, waiting to attack its prey.

hoenn.flavorText: A SNEASEL scales trees by punching its hooked claws into the bark. It seeks out unguarded nests and steals eggs for food while the parents are away.

original-sinnoh.flavorText: It is extremely vicious and will not stop attacking until its foe is incapable of moving.

extended-sinnoh.flavorText: A smart and sneaky Pokémon. A pair may work together to steal eggs by having one lure the parents away.

updated-johto.flavorText: Vicious in nature, it drives PIDGEY from their nests and scavenges any leftovers it can find.

original-unova.flavorText: A smart and sneaky Pokémon. A pair may work together to steal eggs by having one lure the parents away.

updated-unova.flavorText: A smart and sneaky Pokémon, it makes its opponents flinch by suddenly showing the claws hidden in its paws.

kalos.flavorText: Its paws conceal sharp claws. If attacked, it suddenly extends the claws and startles its enemy.

updated-hoenn.flavorText: Sneasel scales trees by punching its hooked claws into the bark. This Pokémon seeks out unguarded nests and steals eggs for food while the parents are away.

original-alola.flavorText: It uses its claws to poke holes in eggs so it can slurp out the insides. Breeders consider it a scourge and will drive it away or eradicate it.

updated-alola.flavorText: It blends into the dark of night to ambush its prey. Sneasel will attack Sandshrew, but its hard skin can cause Sneasel’s claws to snap off.

swsh.flavorText: It has a cunning yet savage disposition. It waits for parents to leave their nests, and then it sneaks in to steal their eggs.

pla.flavorText: Its sturdy, curved claws are ideal for traversing precipitous cliffs. From the tips of these claws drips a venom that infiltrates the nerves of any prey caught in Sneasel's grasp.
